advancements.sevendeadlygods.root.title: Seven Deadly Gods
advancements.sevendeadlygods.root.descri: The Seven Deadly Sins silently watch the fate of the world.
You deciphered the sacred scriptures and learned how to build the Altar of Greed.
You deciphered the sacred scriptures and learned how to build the Altar of Wrath.
advancements.sevendeadlygods.cult_glutto: You deciphered the sacred scriptures and learned how to build the Altar of Gluttony.
You deciphered the sacred scriptures and learned how to build the Altar of Pride.
advancements.sevendeadlygods.cult_envy.d: You deciphered the sacred scriptures and learned how to build the Altar of Envy.
You deciphered the sacred scriptures and learned how to build the Altar of Sloth.
advancements.sevendeadlygods.cult_lust.d: You deciphered the sacred scriptures and learned how to build the Altar of Lust.
advancements.sevendeadlygods.lore_collec: Find and decipher 10 sacred scriptures of the Deadly Sins.
Gather more than half of the arcane texts (25 sacred books read).
Decipher at least 40 of the 49 sacred tomes recording the history and shrines of the unholy pantheon.
advancements.sevendeadlygods.wrath_tier_: Awaken the displeasure of a deity (-20 Favor). Thunder warns of your transgression.
Reach -60 Favor with any god. Their Envoys have been dispatched to punish your insolence.
Be declared a heretic (-80 Favor). Winged Acolytes descend to hunt your soul.
Exhaust divine patience (-100 Favor) and unleash the wrath of the Avatar in person.
advancements.sevendeadlygods.favor_tier_: Earn the initial sympathy of a deity (+20 Favor).
Reach the rank of Disciple (+61 Favor) and master blessing rites at their altar.
Be consecrated as the Chosen (+85 Favor). Winged Acolytes will take flight to protect you.
Become a Champion (+91 Favor) and receive miraculous salvation from the jaws of death.
Attain supreme communion (+100 Favor) and claim their Sacred Relic at the altar.
advancements.sevendeadlygods.secret_god_: Your prayers shattered the heavens: a deity physically descended upon your call.
advancements.sevendeadlygods.village_dis: Enter a village consecrated to one of the Seven Deadly Sins.
advancements.sevendeadlygods.divine_trad: Unlock supreme offerings by completing a Tier 5 trade with a Sentinel Acolyte (Favor >= 60).
advancements.sevendeadlygods.divine_war_: Sound the Divine War Horn to declare an incursion against a rival temple.
advancements.sevendeadlygods.defend_shri: Repel a holy incursion and defend your deity's consecrated shrine.
advancements.sevendeadlygods.temple_conq: Destroy or reconsecrate a rival temple during a Holy War.
advancements.sevendeadlygods.village_mir: Revitalize a desolate village by performing a miracle at the altar with a Totem of Undying and a Golden Apple.
advancements.sevendeadlygods.slay_god_av: Slay a physical manifestation of a God Avatar.
advancements.sevendeadlygods.secret_high: Attack the villagers or altar of your own deity, suffering immediate heresy and punishment.
advancements.sevendeadlygods.secret_clas: Witness two opposing God Avatars descend and clash in the same holy war.
advancements.sevendeadlygods.secret_ruin: Visit a desolated village whose inhabitants starved in jealousy.
advancements.sevendeadlygods.secret_slot: Achieve supreme stillness by resting alongside Belphegor's lethargic flock.
advancements.sevendeadlygods.secret_prid: Bend the knee before the aristocratic subjects of Lucian to earn an audience.
advancements.sevendeadlygods.secret_gree: Pay a gold nugget toll just to open a storage chest in Mammon's domain.
advancements.sevendeadlygods.secret_lust: Witness the uncontrollable fertility spreading among animals in Asmodeus's shrine.
